report.summary: Patient P-D007 (age 66, Original Medicare, no supplemental plan or Medicare transport benefit) needs transport options for medical appointments. Eligible/likely options in tract 17031681000: Senior Shuttle West (free rides for adults 60+, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM) and Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification; up to 21 days for decision). Medicaid Ride Line is not eligible (requires Medicaid plan membership). Kidney Care Rides is listed as open to everyone but is kidney-care focused; suitability depends on patient's condition. No phone numbers were returned by the resource directory, so call the clinic or contact each program for enrollment details.
